steps.title: Mode surfaces
steps.note: ChatView accepts a mode prop of 'chat', 'cowork', or 'code' and maps it to an AgentModeSurface. This is where the 4D framework meets the UI: different modes expose different agent capabilities and review surfaces.

steps.title: Embedded native sessions
steps.note: Active native sessions are embedded via activeNativeSessionId. The UI fetches messages and canvases so the operator can inspect every turn and artifact before approving the next action.

steps.title: Pending permissions and questions
steps.note: usePendingPermissions and usePendingQuestions render info bars in the composer. These are the human-in-the-loop hooks that turn delegation into a gated conversation rather than a black box.
